content.comment_body: Hello! I am using a [product_name] [version_no] module and need to log data from kWh meters with pulse outputs. I have four kWh meters, each giving 800 pulses per kWh, and I need to record their energy consumption. After searching, I could not find any useful resources. Any advice would be appreciated! [user_name]
Hi, There is an example available on the [company_name] website: [url] Hope this is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: User seeks software or instructions to log energy consumption data from multiple kWh meters with pulse outputs using a [product_name] module. The main challenge is the lack of accessible and clear resources or recommendations for performing pulse output logging, which hinders users looking for straightforward solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects an easy-to-use, officially recommended software from [company_name] to log kWh meter pulse outputs with their [product_name] module.
